title: Orka — VM Slot Capacity
description: Apple silicon VM slots (apple.com/vm) per node and Orka namespace, from kube-state-metrics. Requires the optional ksm-tunnel / KSM_TARGET setup.

options.content: Each Apple silicon node advertises its VM slots as the Kubernetes resource `apple.com/vm`; every VM holds one. **0 free slots in a namespace** is exactly when Orka returns *“The maximum supported number of Apple silicon VMs has been reached”* — even if CPU and memory are free. In use counts only Pending/Running pods scheduled to a node. A VM also needs free CPU/memory, so free slots tell you when a deploy **cannot** succeed, not that it will. Source: kube-state-metrics (`kube_node_status_allocatable`, `kube_pod_container_resource_requests`, `kube_node_labels`, `kube_pod_status_phase`).

targets.expr: sum(kube_node_status_allocatable{cluster=~"$cluster",resource="apple_com_vm"} * on(node) group_left(label_orka_macstadium_com_namespace) kube_node_labels{cluster=~"$cluster",label_orka_macstadium_com_namespace=~"$namespace"})

sum((kube_pod_container_resource_requests{cluster=~"$cluster",resource="apple_com_vm"} * on(namespace, pod) group_left() (max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{cluster=~"$cluster",phase=~"Pending|Running"}) == 1)) * on(node) group_left(label_orka_macstadium_com_namespace) kube_node_labels{cluster=~"$cluster",label_orka_macstadium_com_namespace=~"$namespace"}) or vector(0)

panels.title: Free slots
panels.description: Free apple.com/vm slots across the selected namespaces. Red = no slot left: new deploys fail with 'maximum supported number of Apple silicon VMs'.

panels.title: VMs waiting for a slot
panels.description: VM pods the scheduler could not place (PodScheduled=false) that need an apple.com/vm slot.

panels.title: Live: VM slots per Orka namespace
panels.description: Updates every refresh (5s). Counts change as VMs start/stop; lag = scrape interval + kube-state-metrics watch.
